Local Knowledge

St. Petersburg Remodeling — Historic Homes & Condos

Unique Building Contractors brings Florida Certified Building Contractor credentials (CBC1268844) and experience across all of these housing types. We understand the difference between working in a downtown St. Pete high-rise — with its COI requirements, elevator logistics, and work-hour constraints — and renovating a 1925 bungalow in Kenwood, where preserving character while updating systems requires a thoughtful approach.

  • Historic bungalows in Kenwood and Old Northeast benefit from kitchen and bathroom updates that respect original architectural character
  • Mid-century homes throughout St. Petersburg are excellent candidates for open-concept reconfigurations
  • Downtown condos require COI documentation, building management coordination, and Pinellas County permits for applicable work
  • Waterfront and Gulf-front properties may face additional permitting layers — we evaluate and manage each project accordingly
  • Gulfport and Pinellas Point neighborhoods frequently request flooring replacements and kitchen remodels
  • Old homes sometimes reveal unforeseen conditions (outdated wiring, plumbing, or subfloor issues) — we plan for these contingencies during the scoping process

About Our St. Petersburg Projects

St. Petersburg's housing diversity — 1920s Kenwood bungalows, downtown high-rises, mid-century Pinellas Point ranches, and Gulf-adjacent residences — means every project calls for a different technical approach. UBC is experienced across all of these housing types and coordinates directly with both Pinellas County and the City of St. Petersburg permitting offices depending on project location.

Condo Remodeling

Condo Remodeling in St. Petersburg

Remodeling a condominium in St. Petersburg's downtown or waterfront buildings requires the same careful coordination as any managed property — compliance with HOA rules, proper licensing and insurance documentation, and thoughtful logistics planning.

📋

HOA & Association Rules

St. Pete condo associations vary widely in their renovation requirements. We review your specific association's rules before scoping work to ensure our approach is fully compliant.

📄

COI & License Documentation

We provide certificates of insurance naming your building's association or management company as required, along with our Florida state contractor license.

🏗️

Permits for Condo Work

We manage Pinellas County permit requirements for all applicable interior remodeling scopes, including plumbing, electrical, and mechanical work.

🛗

Building Logistics

Elevator scheduling, delivery coordination, and common area protection are managed as part of every condo project in St. Pete.

🔧

Plumbing Shutoffs

Plumbing work in condos may require building-level shutoffs coordinated with property management and neighboring units. We plan these in advance.

🏛️

Historic Homes

For bungalows in St. Pete's historic neighborhoods, we work within applicable historic preservation guidelines and evaluate original materials and structure carefully.
